manifest.settings.clipboard.positions.de: Include each line and column in the copy on the clipboard. Only matters when the result is copied.

manifest.settings.safety.warn.large-outp: Warn before extracting when the document's line count exceeds this threshold

manifest.settings.workspace.excludes.des: Glob patterns of more files a folder or workspace scan skips, on top of the built-in list. Example: **/fixtures/**
manifest.settings.workspace.max-files.de: The most files one folder or workspace scan reads
The most results one folder or workspace scan reports before it stops reading
manifest.settings.workspace.patterns.des: Glob patterns of the files a folder or workspace scan reads
manifest.settings.workspace.gitignore.de: Leave out the files the project's .gitignore files leave out
manifest.settings.workspace.always-inclu: Glob patterns of files a folder or workspace scan reads even when the built-in list or .gitignore would skip them. Example: **/vendor/**
manifest.settings.workspace.binary.desc: Skip images, fonts, archives and other files that are not text
manifest.settings.workspace.default-excl: Skip dependency folders, build output, caches and lockfiles, such as node_modules, dist, .next and package-lock.json
